query: What is the distance between each house and its closest GP surgery in {input_location}?
sql: WITH houses AS (  SELECT    osid,    buildinguse_oslandusetiera,    geometry,    st_buffer(geometry, 5000) AS search_geometry,    geometry_wgs84  FROM    product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building  WHERE    buildinguse_addresscount_residential > 0    AND {input_location}),gp_sites AS (  SELECT    osid,    description,    geometry  FROM    product_data_store.sites.ngd_sites  WHERE    description = 'Health Centre'    AND {input_location}),candidates AS (  SELECT    h.osid,    h.geometry AS h_geometry,    gp.geometry AS gp_geometry,    gp.description as gp_description,    h.geometry_wgs84  FROM    houses h      JOIN gp_sites gp        ON st_intersects(h.search_geometry, gp.geometry)),ranked AS (  SELECT    osid,    h_geometry,    gp_geometry,    geometry_wgs84,    st_distance(st_setsrid(h_geometry, 27700), st_setsrid(gp_geometry, 27700)) AS distance_m,    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY osid ORDER BY st_distance(h_geometry, gp_geometry)) AS rn  FROM    candidates)SELECT  osid,  distance_m,  geometry_wgs84FROM  ranked WHERE  rn = 1
notes: Assumes a 5km search window.

query: What is the nearest school to each residence in {input_location}?
sql: WITH houses AS (  SELECT    osid,    buildinguse_oslandusetiera,    geometry,    st_buffer(geometry, 5000) AS search_geometry,    geometry_wgs84  FROM    product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building  WHERE   buildinguse_addresscount_residential > 0    AND {input_location}),sch_sites AS (  SELECT    osid,    description,    geometry  FROM    product_data_store.sites.ngd_sites  WHERE    description = 'School'    AND {input_location}),candidates AS (  SELECT    h.osid,    sch.osid AS near_osid,    h.geometry AS h_geometry,    sch.geometry AS sch_geometry,    h.geometry_wgs84  FROM    houses h      JOIN sch_sites sch        ON st_intersects(h.search_geometry, sch.geometry)),ranked AS (  SELECT    osid,    near_osid,    h_geometry,    sch_geometry,    geometry_wgs84,    st_distance(st_setsrid(h_geometry, 27700), st_setsrid(sch_geometry,27700)) AS distance_m,    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY osid ORDER BY st_distance(h_geometry, sch_geometry)) AS row_number  FROM    candidates)SELECT  osid,  near_osid,  geometry_wgs84FROM  rankedWHERE  row_number = 1
